REQ-001.design_rationale: Section 2.1 details importing Carbon, adding isSecureInput to KeyEventContext, implementing EventTapCoordinator.isSecureEventInputActive() via IsSecureEventInputEnabled(), and routing evaluateKeyEvent to clearCandidates() and return .passThrough(resetSession: true) when isSecureInput is true.
REQ-001.tasks_rationale: Task 1 (subtask 1.2) explicitly implements isSecureInput and isSecureEventInputActive() in EventTapCoordinator.swift, and Task 4 (subtask 4.1) specifies automated unit tests.
REQ-001.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-001: Secure Input bypasses Vietnamese composition and clears candidate bar' passed after 0.001s.

REQ-002.design_rationale: Section 2.1 designs EventTapCoordinator.isLauncherApp(bundleId:) for Spotlight, Raycast, and Alfred bundle IDs, and updates isSpotlightOverlayVisible to inspect on-screen window layers (kCGWindowLayer > 0) owned by Spotlight, Raycast, or Alfred, returning .passThrough(resetSession: true) in evaluateKeyEvent.
REQ-002.tasks_rationale: Task 1 (subtask 1.2) implements launcher detection and window layer inspection in EventTapCoordinator.swift, and Task 4 (subtask 4.1) provides regression unit tests.
REQ-002.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-002: Universal Launcher overlay detection (Spotlight, Raycast, Alfred)' passed after 0.001s.

REQ-003.design_rationale: Section 2.2 specifies CaretPositionResolver maintaining a thread-safe enabledAccessibilityPIDs cache to set AXManualAccessibility on target PIDs once, and implementing screenContaining(point:) to clamp floating panel coordinates to the active NSScreen.visibleFrame.
REQ-003.tasks_rationale: Task 3 (subtask 3.1) directs implementation of enableManualAccessibilityIfNeeded and screenContaining in CandidateBarController.swift, validated in Task 4.
REQ-003.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-003: Caret accessibility activation and screen resolution' passed after 0.003s.

REQ-004.design_rationale: Section 2.3 removes the !isConsonant(CHR(ii)) restriction in VietnameseEngine.checkRestoreIfWrongSpelling to inspect all syllable positions for TONE_MASK (including KEY_D / đ) and MARK_MASK / TONEW_MASK, while Section 2.1 extends EventTapAction.replaceKeystroke with passThroughTrailingKey to preserve trailing control keys.
REQ-004.tasks_rationale: Task 1 (subtask 1.1) implements the checkRestoreIfWrongSpelling logic, subtask 1.2 wires passThroughTrailingKey in EventTapCoordinator.swift, and Task 4 provides unit test coverage for dead/added/window.
REQ-004.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-004: English word auto-restore without skipping KEY_D and trailing key pass-through' passed after 0.001s.

REQ-005.design_rationale: Section 2.4 specifies AutoWordingEngine tracking userFrequencies in UserDefaults, implementing recordCandidateAcceptance(text:) and resetLearnedFrequencies(), boosting candidate sorting before truncating to top 3, while Section 2.1, 2.2, and SettingsView UI wire acceptance triggers and reset controls.
REQ-005.tasks_rationale: Task 2 (subtask 2.1) implements frequency storage and sorting in AutoWordingEngine.swift, Task 3 adds click tracking and SettingsView reset UI, and Task 4 covers unit tests.
REQ-005.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-005: Adaptive candidate frequency learning and ranking boost' passed after 0.001s.

REQ-006.design_rationale: Section 2.4 specifies expanding AutoWordingEngine.shorthandTable with high-frequency shorthands (k, j, bh, mn, cty, nv, gd, sdt, tks), adding customShorthands dictionary in OpenKeySettingsStore persisted under CustomShorthandsData, evaluating custom entries prior to built-in entries, and adding inline management controls in SettingsView.
REQ-006.tasks_rationale: Task 2 (subtask 2.1 & 2.2) implements the expanded and custom shorthand tables and store persistence, Task 3 (subtask 3.2) provides SettingsView UI, and Task 4 verifies with unit tests.
REQ-006.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-006: Expanded built-in and custom shorthand table persistence' passed after 0.001s, along with production build and active deployment verification (PID 66185).

REQ-007.design_rationale: Section 2.3 specifies bounds checking in CHR(_:) (guard idx >= 0 && idx < Int(index) && idx < maxBuff else return KEY_EMPTY), guarding hookOutput mutations in insertMark behind if canModifyFlag, clearing hookOutput on handleKeyEvent entry and returning zeroed backspaceCount/newCharCount when hookOutput.code is doNothing, synchronizing keyStates and stateIndex on KEY_DELETE and restoreLastTypingState(), clearing typingStates on resetSession() and shorthand expansion, and restricting repairPhonotacticClusterIfNeeded in checkGrammar to forward keystrokes (deltaBackSpace <= 0).
REQ-007.tasks_rationale: Task 5 (subtasks 5.1 and 5.2) details the 5 multi-delete fixes in VietnameseEngine.swift and EventTapCoordinator.swift, plus TDD regression tests for toned word delete pass-through, partial delete + new character entry, multi-word cross-space delete, and post-shorthand delete.
REQ-007.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 1 & Section 2 test 'REQ-007: Multi-Delete and Subsequent Character Entry State Integrity' passed after 0.002s (26/26 tests passed).
